answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #10493

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #494?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #10494

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #495?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #10495

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #496?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #10496

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #497?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #10497

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #498?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #10498

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #499?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #10499

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #500?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #10500

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #501?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10501

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #502?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #10502

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #503?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10503

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #504?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10504

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #505?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #10505

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #506?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #10506

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #507?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #10507

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #508?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10508

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #509?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #10509

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #510?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #10510

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #511?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10511

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #512?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #10512

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #513?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10513

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #514?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #10514

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #515?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10516

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #548?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #10548

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #549?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #10549

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #550?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #10550

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #551?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10551

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #552?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #10552

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #553?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10553

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #554?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10554

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #555?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #10555

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #556?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #10556

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #557?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #10557

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #558?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10558

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #559?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #10559

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #560?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #10560

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #561?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10561

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #562?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #10562

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #563?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10563

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #564?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #10564

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #565?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10565

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #566?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10566

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #567?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #10567

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #568?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #10568

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #569?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #10569

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #10570

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #603?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10603

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #604?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10604

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #605?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #10605

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #606?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #10606

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #607?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #10607

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #608?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10608

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #609?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #10609

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #610?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #10610

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #611?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10611

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #612?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #10612

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #613?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10613

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #614?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #10614

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #615?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10615

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #616?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10616

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #617?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #10617

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #618?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #10618

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #619?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #10656

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #657?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #10657

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #658?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10658

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #659?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #10659

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #660?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #10660

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #661?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10661

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #662?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #10662

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #663?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10663

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #664?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #10664

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #665?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10665

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #666?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10666

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #667?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #10667

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #668?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #10668

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #669?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #10669

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #670?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #10670

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #671?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #10671

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #672?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #10672

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #673?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #10673

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #674?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #10674

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #675?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #10675

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #676?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10676

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #677?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #10677

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #678?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10678

answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10679

answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10711

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #712?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #10712

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #713?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10713

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #714?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #10714

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #715?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10715

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #716?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10716

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #717?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #10717

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #718?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #10718

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #719?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #10719

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #720?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #10720

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #721?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #10721

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #722?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #10722

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #723?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #10723

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #724?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #10724

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #725?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #10725

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #726?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10726

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #727?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #10727

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #728?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10728

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #729?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10729

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #730?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #10730

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #731?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #10731

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #732?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #10732

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #733?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10733

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #734?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #10734

answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10766

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #767?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #10767

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #768?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #10768

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #769?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #10769

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #770?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #10770

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #771?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #10771

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #772?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #10772

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #773?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #10773

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #774?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #10774

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #775?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #10775

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #776?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10776

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #777?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #10777

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #778?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10778

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #779?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10779

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #780?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #10780

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #781?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #10781

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #782?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #10782

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #783?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10783

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #784?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #10784

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #785?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #10785

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #786?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10786

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #787?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #10787

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #788?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10788

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #789?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #10789

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #821?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #10821

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #822?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #10822

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #823?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #10823

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #824?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #10824

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #825?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #10825

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #826?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10826

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #827?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #10827

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #828?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10828

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #829?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10829

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #830?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #10830

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #831?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #10831

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #832?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #10832

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #833?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10833

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #834?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #10834

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #835?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #10835

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #836?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10836

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #837?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #10837

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #838?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10838

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #839?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #10839

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #840?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10840

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #841?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10841

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #842?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #10842

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #843?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #10843

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #844?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #10844

answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #10875

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #876?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10876

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #877?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #10877

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #878?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #10878

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #879?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10879

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #880?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #10880

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #881?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #10881

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #882?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #10882

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #883?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10883

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #884?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #10884

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #885?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #10885

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #886?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10886

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #887?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #10887

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #888?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #10888

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #889?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #10889

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #890?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10890

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #891?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #10891

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #892?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #10892

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #893?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #10893

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #894?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #10894

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #895?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #10895

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #896?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #10896

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #897?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #10897

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #10898
