Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #11906

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #1907?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #11907

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #1908?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #11908

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #1909?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #11909

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1910?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #11910

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1911?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #11911

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1912?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #11912

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #1913?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #11913

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1914?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #11914

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #1915?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #11915

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1916?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #11916

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #1917?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #11917

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #1918?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #11918

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1919?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #11919

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #1920?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #11920

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1921?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #11921

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #1922?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #11922

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #1923?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #11923

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #1924?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #11924

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #1925?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #11925

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #1926?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #11926

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #1927?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #11927

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1928?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #11928

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #1929?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #11929

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #1930?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #11930

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1961?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #11961

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1962?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #11962

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #1963?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #11963

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1964?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #11964

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #1965?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #11965

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1966?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #11966

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #1967?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #11967

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #1968?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #11968

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1969?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #11969

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #1970?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #11970

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1971?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #11971

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #1972?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #11972

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #1973?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #11973

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #1974?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #11974

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #1975?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #11975

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #1976?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #11976

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #1977?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #11977

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #1978?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.

answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12015

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2016?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12016

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #2017?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #12017

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #2018?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #12018

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2019?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #12019

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2020?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #12020

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2021?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #12021

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #2022?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #12022

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #2023?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #12023

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #2024?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #12024

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #2025?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #12025

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #2026?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12026

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #2027?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #12027

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2028?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12028

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2029?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12029

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #2030?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #12030

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2031?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #12031

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #2032?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #12032

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #2033?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12033

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2034?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #12034

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #12035

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2036?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12036

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2037?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #12037

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #12069

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2070?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #12070

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2071?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #12071

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #2072?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #12072

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #2073?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #12073

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #2074?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #12074

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #2075?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #12075

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #2076?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12076

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #2077?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #12077

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2078?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12078

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2079?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12079

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #2080?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #12080

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2081?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #12081

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #2082?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #12082

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #2083?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12083

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2084?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #12084

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2085?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #12085

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2086?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12086

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2087?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #12087

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2088?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12088

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2089?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #12089

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2090?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12090

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2091?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12091

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #2092?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #12092

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #2093?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #12093

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #12123

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #2124?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #12124

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #2125?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #12125

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #2126?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12126

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #2127?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #12127

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2128?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12128

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2129?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12129

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #2130?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #12130

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2131?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #12131

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #2132?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #12132

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #2133?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12133

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2134?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #12134

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2135?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #12135

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2136?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12136

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2137?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #12137

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2138?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12138

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2139?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #12139

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2140?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12140

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2141?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12141

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #2142?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #12142

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #2143?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #12143

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2144?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #12144

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2145?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #12145

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2146?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #12146

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #2147?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #12147

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #2180?

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2181?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #12181

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #2182?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #2183?

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2184?

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2185?

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2186?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12186

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2187?

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2188?

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2189?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12191

Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #12231

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #2232?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #12232

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #2233?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12233

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2234?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #12234

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2235?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #12235

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2236?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12236

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2237?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #12237

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2238?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12238

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2239?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #12239

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2240?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12240

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2241?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12241

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #2242?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #12242

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #2243?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #12243

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2244?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #12244

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2245?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #12245

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2246?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #12246

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #2247?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #12247

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #2248?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #12248

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #2249?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #12249

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #2250?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #12250

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #2251?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12251

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #2252?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #12252

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2253?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12253

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2254?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12254

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #2255?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #12255

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #12285

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2286?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12286

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2287?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #12287

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2288?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12288

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2289?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #12289

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2290?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12290

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2291?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12291

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #2292?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #12292

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #2293?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #12293

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2294?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #12294

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2295?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #12295

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2296?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #12296

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #2297?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #12297

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #2298?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #12298

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #2299?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #12299

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #2300?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #12300

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #2301?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12301

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #2302?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #12302

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2303?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12303

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2304?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12304

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #2305?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #12305

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2306?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #12306

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #2307?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #12307

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #2308?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12308

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2309?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #12309

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2340?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12340

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2341?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12341

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #2342?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #12342

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #2343?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #12343

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2344?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #12344

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2345?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #12345

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2346?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #12346

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #2347?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #12347

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #2348?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #12348

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #2349?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #12349

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #2350?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #12350

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #2351?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12351

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #2352?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #12352

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2353?
