answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #12394

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2395?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #12395

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2396?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #12396

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #2397?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #12397

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #2398?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #12398

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #2399?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #12399

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #2400?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #12400

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #2401?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12401

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #2402?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #12402

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2403?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12403

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2404?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12404

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #2405?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #12405

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2406?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #12406

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #2407?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #12407

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #2408?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12408

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2409?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #12409

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2410?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #12410

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2411?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12411

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2412?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #12412

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2413?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12413

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2414?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #12414

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2415?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12415

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2416?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12416

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #2417?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #12417

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #2418?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #12418

answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #12448

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #2449?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #12449

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #2450?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #12450

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #2451?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12451

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #2452?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #12452

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2453?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12453

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2454?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12454

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #2455?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #12455

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2456?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #12456

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #2457?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #12457

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #2458?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12458

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2459?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #12459

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2460?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #12460

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2461?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12461

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2462?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #12462

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2463?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12463

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2464?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #12464

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2465?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12465

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2466?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12466

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #2467?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #12467

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #2468?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #12468

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2469?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #12469

answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #12470

answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.

answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #12502

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2503?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12503

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2504?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12504

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #2505?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #12505

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2506?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #12506

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #2507?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #12507

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #2508?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12508

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2509?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #12509

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2510?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #12510

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2511?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12511

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2512?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #12512

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2513?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12513

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2514?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #12514

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2515?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12515

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2516?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12516

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #2517?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #12517

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #2518?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.

Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #12556

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #2557?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #12557

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #2558?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12558

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2559?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #12559

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2560?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #12560

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2561?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12561

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2562?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #12562

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2563?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12563

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2564?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #12564

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2565?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12565

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2566?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12566

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #2567?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #12567

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #2568?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #12568

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2569?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #12569

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2570?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #12570

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2571?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #12571

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #2572?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #12572

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #2573?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #12573

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #2574?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #12574

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #2575?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #12575

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #2576?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12576

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #2577?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #12577

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2578?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12578

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2579?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12579

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #2580?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #12580

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #12610

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2611?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12611

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2612?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #12612

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2613?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12613

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2614?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #12614

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2615?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12615

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2616?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12616

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #2617?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #12617

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #2618?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #12618

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2619?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #12619

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2620?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #12620

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2621?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #12621

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #2622?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #12622

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #2623?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #12623

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #2624?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #12624

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #2625?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #12625

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #2626?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12626

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #2627?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #12627

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2628?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12628

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2629?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12629

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #2630?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #12630

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2631?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #12631

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #2632?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #12632

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #2633?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12633

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2634?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #12634

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2665?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12665

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2666?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12666

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #2667?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #12667

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #2668?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #12668

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2669?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #12669

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2670?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #12670

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2671?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #12671

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #2672?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #12672

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #2673?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #12673

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #2674?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #12674

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #2675?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #12675

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #2676?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12676

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #2677?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #12677

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2678?

answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #12719

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2720?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #12720

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2721?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #12721

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #2722?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #12722

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #2723?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #12723

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #2724?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #12724

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #2725?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #12725

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #2726?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12726

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #2727?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #12727

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2728?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12728

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2729?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12729

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #2730?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #12730

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2731?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #12731

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #2732?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #12732

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #2733?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12733

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2734?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #12734

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2735?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #12735

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2736?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12736

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2737?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #12737

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2738?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12738

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2739?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #12739

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2740?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12740

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2741?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12741

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #2742?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #12742

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #2743?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #12743

answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #12773

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #2774?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #12774

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #2775?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #12775

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #2776?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12776

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #2777?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #12777

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2778?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12778

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2779?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12779

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #2780?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #12780

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2781?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #12781

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #2782?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #12782

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #2783?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12783

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2784?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #12784

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2785?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #12785

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2786?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12786

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2787?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #12787

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2788?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12788

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2789?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #12789

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2790?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12790

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2791?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12791

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #2792?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #12792

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #2793?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #12793

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2794?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #12794

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2795?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #12795

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2796?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #12796

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2828?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #12828

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2829?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12829

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #2830?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #12830

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2831?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #12831

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #2832?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #12832

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #2833?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12833

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #2834?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #12834

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2835?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #12835

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2836?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12836

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2837?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #12837

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2838?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #12838

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2839?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #12839

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #2840?

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #2841?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #12841
