answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #13369

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3370?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #13370

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3371?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #13371

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #3372?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #13372

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #3373?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #13373

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #3374?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #13374

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #3375?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #13375

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #3376?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13376

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #3377?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #13377

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3378?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13378

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3379?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #13379

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #3380?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #13380

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3381?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #13381

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #3382?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #13382

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #3383?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13383

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3384?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #13384

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3385?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #13385

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3386?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13386

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3387?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #13387

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3388?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #13388

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3389?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #13389

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3390?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13390

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3391?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13391

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #3392?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #13392

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #3393?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #13393

answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #13423

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #3424?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #13424

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #3425?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #13425

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #3426?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13426

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #3427?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #13427

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3428?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13428

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3429?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #13429

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #3430?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #13430

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3431?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #13431

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #3432?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #13432

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #3433?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13433

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3434?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #13434

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3435?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #13435

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3436?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13436

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3437?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #13437

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3438?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #13438

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3439?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #13439

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3440?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13440

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3441?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13441

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #3442?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #13442

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #3443?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #13443

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3444?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #13444

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #13445

answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3478?

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3479?

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #3480?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #13480

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3481?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #13481

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #3482?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #13482

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #3483?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13483

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3484?

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3485?

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3486?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13486

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3487?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #13487

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3488?

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3489?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #13489

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3490?

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3491?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13491

Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #13531

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #3532?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #13532

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #3533?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13533

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3534?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #13534

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3535?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #13535

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3536?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13536

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3537?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #13537

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3538?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #13538

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3539?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #13539

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3540?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13540

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3541?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13541

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #3542?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #13542

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #3543?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #13543

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3544?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #13544

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3545?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #13545

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3546?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #13546

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #3547?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #13547

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #3548?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #13548

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #3549?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #13549

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #3550?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #13550

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #3551?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13551

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #3552?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #13552

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3553?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13553

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3554?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #13554

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #3555?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #13555

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #13585

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3586?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13586

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3587?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #13587

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3588?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #13588

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3589?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #13589

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3590?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13590

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3591?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13591

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #3592?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #13592

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #3593?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #13593

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3594?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #13594

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3595?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #13595

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3596?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #13596

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #3597?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #13597

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #3598?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #13598

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #3599?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #13599

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #3600?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #13600

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #3601?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13601

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #3602?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #13602

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3603?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13603

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3604?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #13604

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #3605?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #13605

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3606?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #13606

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #3607?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #13607

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #3608?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13608

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3609?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #13609

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3640?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13640

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3641?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13641

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #3642?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #13642

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #3643?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #13643

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3644?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #13644

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3645?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #13645

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3646?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #13646

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #3647?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #13647

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #3648?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #13648

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #3649?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #13649

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #3650?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #13650

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #3651?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13651

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #3652?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #13652

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3653?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13653

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3654?

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #3655?

answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #13694

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3695?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #13695

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3696?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #13696

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #3697?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #13697

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #3698?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #13698

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #3699?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #13699

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #3700?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #13700

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #3701?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13701

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #3702?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #13702

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3703?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13703

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3704?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #13704

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #3705?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #13705

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3706?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #13706

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #3707?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #13707

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #3708?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13708

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3709?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #13709

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3710?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #13710

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3711?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13711

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3712?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #13712

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3713?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #13713

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3714?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #13714

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3715?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13715

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3716?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13716

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #3717?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #13717

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #3718?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #13718

answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #13748

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #3749?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #13749

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #3750?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #13750

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #3751?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13751

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #3752?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #13752

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3753?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13753

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3754?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #13754

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #3755?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #13755

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3756?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #13756

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #3757?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #13757

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #3758?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13758

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3759?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #13759

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3760?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #13760

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3761?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13761

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3762?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #13762

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3763?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #13763

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3764?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #13764

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3765?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13765

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3766?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13766

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #3767?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #13767

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #3768?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #13768

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3769?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #13769

answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #13770

answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3803?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #13803

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3804?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #13804

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #3805?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #13805

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3806?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #13806

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #3807?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #13807

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #3808?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13808

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #3809?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #13809

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3810?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #13810

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3811?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13811

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3812?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #13812

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3813?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #13813

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3814?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #13814

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #3815?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13815

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #3816?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #13816

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #3817?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #13817

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #3818?
