answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #14398

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #4399?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #14399

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #4400?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #14400

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #4401?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14401

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #4402?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #14402

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4403?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14403

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4404?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #14404

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #4405?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #14405

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4406?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #14406

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #4407?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #14407

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #4408?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14408

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4409?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #14409

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4410?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #14410

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4411?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14411

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4412?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #14412

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4413?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #14413

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4414?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #14414

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4415?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14415

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4416?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14416

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #4417?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #14417

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #4418?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #14418

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4419?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #14419

answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #14420

answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #4455?

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4456?

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #4457?

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #4458?

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4459?

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4460?

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4461?

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4462?

Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #14506

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #4507?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #14507

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #4508?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14508

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4509?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #14509

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4510?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #14510

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4511?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14511

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4512?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #14512

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4513?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #14513

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4514?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #14514

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4515?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14515

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4516?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14516

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #4517?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #14517

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #4518?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #14518

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4519?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #14519

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4520?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #14520

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4521?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #14521

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #4522?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #14522

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #4523?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #14523

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #4524?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #14524

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #4525?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #14525

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #4526?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14526

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #4527?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #14527

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4528?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14528

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4529?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #14529

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #4530?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #14530

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #14560

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4561?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14561

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4562?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #14562

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4563?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #14563

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4564?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #14564

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4565?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14565

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4566?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14566

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #4567?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #14567

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #4568?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #14568

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4569?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #14569

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4570?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #14570

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4571?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #14571

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #4572?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #14572

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #4573?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #14573

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #4574?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #14574

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #4575?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #14575

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #4576?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14576

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #4577?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #14577

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4578?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14578

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4579?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #14579

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #4580?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #14580

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4581?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #14581

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #4582?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #14582

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #4583?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14583

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4584?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #14584

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4615?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14615

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4616?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14616

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #4617?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #14617

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #4618?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #14618

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4619?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #14619

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4620?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #14620

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4621?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #14621

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #4622?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #14622

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #4623?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #14623

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #4624?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #14624

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #4625?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #14625

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #4626?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14626

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #4627?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #14627

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4628?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14628

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4629?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #14630

answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #14669

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4670?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #14670

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4671?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #14671

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #4672?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #14672

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #4673?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #14673

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #4674?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #14674

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #4675?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #14675

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #4676?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14676

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #4677?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #14677

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4678?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14678

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4679?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #14679

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #4680?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #14680

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4681?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #14681

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #4682?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #14682

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #4683?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14683

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4684?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #14684

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4685?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #14685

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4686?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14686

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4687?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #14687

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4688?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #14688

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4689?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #14689

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4690?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14690

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4691?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14691

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #4692?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #14692

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #4693?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #14693

answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #14723

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #4724?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #14724

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #4725?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #14725

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #4726?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14726

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #4727?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #14727

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4728?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14728

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4729?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #14729

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #4730?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #14730

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4731?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #14731

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #4732?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #14732

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #4733?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14733

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4734?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #14734

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4735?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #14735

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4736?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14736

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4737?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #14737

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4738?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #14738

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4739?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #14739

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4740?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14740

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4741?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14741

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #4742?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #14742

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #4743?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #14743

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4744?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #14744

answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #14745

answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4778?

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #4780?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #14780

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4781?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #14781

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #4782?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #14782

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #4783?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14783

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4784?

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4785?

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4786?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14786

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4787?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #14787

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4788?

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4789?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #14789

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4790?

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14791

Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #14831

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #4832?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #14832

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #4833?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14833

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4834?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #14834

question: Kya soodi loan lekar ghar kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4835?
answer: Nahi, sood par bank se loan lekar ghar kharidna shariah mein haram hai. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo aisi soodi deals se bachein aur Islamic banks ke Diminishing Musharakah (sajha kirdari) model ke zariye ghar khareedne ka raasta apnayein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #14835

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4836?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14836

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4837?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #14837

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4838?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #14838

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4839?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #14839

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4840?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14840

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4841?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14841

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #4842?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #14842

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #4843?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #14843

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4844?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #14844

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4845?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #14845

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4846?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #14846

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #4847?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #14847

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #4848?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #14848

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #4849?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #14849

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #4850?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #14850

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #4851?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14851

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #4852?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #14852

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4853?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14853

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4854?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #14854

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #4855?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #14855

reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Gharelu Financing, Fatwa Ref #14885

question: Kya sone (gold) ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4886?
answer: Sone aur chandi ki kharid-o-faroopt mein haath-o-haath (immediate delivery and payment) hona zaroori hai. Isliye sone ko kishto (installments) par kharidna jaiz nahi hai, jab tak ke sone par qabza aur paise ki poori adayegi ek hi waqt mein na ho.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Saraf ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14886

question: Kya online forex trading karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4887?
answer: Online forex trading mein aam taur par leverage, futures contracts, aur currencies par haqeeqi qabza (possession) na hone ki wajah se shariah ke mutabiq yeh jaiz nahi hai. Isme soodi charges (swap rates) bhi shamil hote hain, isliye forex trading se bachna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Forex Trading, Fatwa Ref #14887

question: Kya digital photography ya video banana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4888?
answer: Digital tasveer aur video jo kisi display screen par dikhayi deti hai aur paper par print na ho, uspar haqeeqi tasveer ka hukum nahi hota. Agar wo gunah ke kaamon aur behayai se paak ho, toh shari'i zaroorat ya educational maqsad ke liye banana jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Tasveer ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #14888

question: Kya pirated software ya copyright material istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4889?
answer: Nahi, kisi ke copyright ya intellectual property ko bina ijazat ke commercial ya personal use ke liye copy karna aur copyright todna jaiz nahi hai. Yeh doosre shakhs ke haq (haq-e-ibtikar) ki khilaf-warzi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Copyright aur Software, Fatwa Ref #14889

question: Kya chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery karwana jaiz hai - Sawaal #4890?
answer: Chehre ya jism ki cosmetic surgery agar kisi aib (defect), accident ke zakham, ya congenital deformity (paidaishi nuks) ko theek karne ke liye ho, toh bilkul jaiz hai. Sirf husn aur khoobsurti badhane ke liye natural jism mein badlav karna jaiz nahi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Ilaj ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14890

question: Kya conventional bank mein job karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4891?
answer: Conventional bank mein aisi naukri karna jisme sood likhna, uski gawahi dena, soodi contract taiyar karna ya soodi calculation karna shamil ho (jaise cashier, accountant, loan officer), bilkul jaiz nahi hai. Aise shakhs ko halal naukri dhoondhni chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14891

question: Sood ke mile huye paise ka kya kiya jaye - Sawaal #4892?
answer: Sood ke paise ko bagair sawab ki niyat ke ghareebon, mohtajon ya zarurat-mando ko dena wajib hai taaki wo haram maal aapki milkiyat se nikal jaye. Ise apne upar ya apne khandan par kharch karna bilkul haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Rudaad-e-Sood, Fatwa Ref #14892

question: Kya bank ke software banane wali company mein IT job jaiz hai - Sawaal #4893?
answer: Agar software special soodi calculations ke liye hi banaya ja raha hai, toh parhez karna chahiye. Lekin agar wo general purpose IT software hai (jaise HR management, security, database storage) jo bank ke alawa doosri companies bhi use karti hain, toh wahan job karna jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Mulazimat, Fatwa Ref #14893

question: Kya IVF (Test Tube Baby) ke zariye aulad haasil karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4894?
answer: Agar sperm aur egg sirf aur sirf haqeeqi mian-biwi ke hon, aur pregnancy biwi ke hi raham (womb) mein grow ki jaye, aur kisi gair mard ya aurat (surrogate mother) ka dakhal na ho, toh shariah ke mutabiq test tube baby ka tariqa jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Tibbi Masail, Fatwa Ref #14894

question: Kya gair-muslimon se unke tyoharo par gifts lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4895?
answer: Han, agar unke tyohar ke shirkya rasmat aur religious rituals ka hissa na ho, aur gift mein di gayi cheez khud halal ho, aur dosti/talluqat normal rakhne ke liye ho, toh unse gifts lena aur unhe aam dino mein gifts dena jaiz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Gair Muslimon se Talluq, Fatwa Ref #14895

question: Kya suwar (pig) ke chamde se bani chizein istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4896?
answer: Nahi, suwar ka chamda najis-ul-ain (apne wajood mein impure) hai aur dabbagat (tanning) se bhi paak nahi hota. Isliye suwar ke chamde se bane shoes, jackets, ya bags ka istemal karna sakht haram aur namaz ke liye na-paaki ka sabab hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Taharah, Fatwa Ref #14896

question: Kya sigret (smoking) peena halal hai - Sawaal #4897?
answer: Sigret peena makruh-e-tahrimi ya haram ke kareeb hai kyunki modern science aur medical research se sabit hai ke yeh insan ke jism aur sehat ko sakht nuqsan pahunchata hai. Apne aap ko nuqsan pahunchana shariah mein mana hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 4, Sigret Noshi, Fatwa Ref #14897

question: Kya machine se zabh kiya hua chicken halal hai - Sawaal #4898?
answer: Machine se slaughtering par scholars mein ixtilaf hai. Fatawa Usmani ke mutabiq, agar machine chalate waqt musalman Bismillah padhe aur machine lagatar chalti rahe, toh kuch shurait ke sath jaiz hai. Lekin hath se zabh karna aur machine se parhez karna afzal aur mehfooz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Halal O Haram, Fatwa Ref #14898

question: Kya kisi bacche ko adopt (god lena) jaiz hai - Sawaal #4899?
answer: Kisi yateem ya be-sahara bacche ko adopt karke uski parwarish karna bohot bada sawab hai. Lekin shariah mein wo baccha adopt karne wale ka haqeeqi beta nahi banta aur na hi use uski viraasat (inheritance) milti hai. Bada hone par usse parda bhi wajib rehta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Aaili Masail, Fatwa Ref #14899

question: Kya waqf ki zameen ya masjid ke saman ko becha ja sakta hai - Sawaal #4900?
answer: Nahi, ek baar jo zameen ya property masjid ya kisi aur khair ke kaam ke liye waqf (endowment) kar di jaye, wo hamesha ke liye Allah ki milkiyat ho jati hai. Use bechna, tohfa dena, ya kisi ki zaati milkiyat mein dena sakht haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 2, Kitab-ul-Waqf, Fatwa Ref #14900

question: Kya digital currency jaise Bitcoin halal hai - Sawaal #4901?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke fatwe ke mutabiq, digital currencies (cryptocurrency) mein haqeeqi maal (tangible asset) ya kisi qaumi bank/hukumat ki clear backing na hone ki wajah se isme bohot zyada speculation (gharar) hoti hai. Isliye filhal cryptocurrency mein trading aur investment se parhez karna chahiye.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14901

question: Kya company ke shares kharidna aur bechna halal hai - Sawaal #4902?
answer: Agar company ka bunyadi karobar halal ho (jaise IT, manufacturing, textiles), aur wo soodi karobar mein shamil na ho, aur company ke paas kuch na kuch tangible assets (jaise zameen, building, machinery) maujood hon, toh aisi company ke shares ki kharid-o-faroopt jaiz hai. Soodi companies jaise banks ke shares lena haram hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Karobar aur Shares, Fatwa Ref #14902

question: Kya credit card ka istemal karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4903?
answer: Agar credit card ke dues ko free-interest period ke andar-andar ada kar diya jaye aur bank ko koi sood (interest) na dena pade, toh credit card ka istemal bilkul jaiz hai. Lekin late payment se har haal mein bachna farz hai kyunki late fee par sood lagta hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Kitab-ul-Buyoo, Fatwa Ref #14903

question: Kya conventional life insurance lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4904?
answer: Nahi, conventional life insurance shariah mein jaiz nahi hai kyunki isme sood (interest) aur qimar (gambling) dono shamil hote hain. Musalmano ko chahiye ke wo conventional insurance se bachein aur shariah compliant Takaful ka rukh karein.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Bima Policy ka Hukm, Fatwa Ref #14904

question: Kya Islamic Takaful scheme mein shamil hona jaiz hai - Sawaal #4905?
answer: Ji haan, Shariah-compliant Islamic Takaful scheme waqf aur tabarru (donation) ke shari'i usoolon par kaam karti hai. Isme shamil hona aur isse faida uthana bilkul jaiz hai, kyunki yeh conventional insurance ki tarah sood aur gambling par mabni nahi hoti.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Takaful aur Shariah, Fatwa Ref #14905

question: Kya maut ke baad jism ke aaza (organs) donate karna jaiz hai - Sawaal #4906?
answer: Mufti Taqi Usmani Sahab ke mutabiq, insani jism ki hurmat aur karamat ki wajah se aaza ko bechna ya unki tijarat karna bilkul haram hai. Lekin agar kisi ki jaan bachana maqsad ho aur koi aur halal ilaaj maujood na ho, toh be-dhadak bina kisi paise ke aaza donate karne ke baare mein strict shurait ke sath kuch ijazat di gayi hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 1, Aaza ki Peondkari, Fatwa Ref #14906

question: Kya kagazi note (paper currency) par sood ka hukum lagu hota hai - Sawaal #4907?
answer: Ji haan, kagazi note (fiat currency) ko shariah mein zariya-e-tabadlah (medium of exchange) aur qeemat ka darja haasil hai. Isliye in par bhi sood (riba) ke wahi ahqamat lagu hote hain jo sone aur chandi ke len-den par hote the.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Riba aur Kagazi Note, Fatwa Ref #14907

question: Kya bank account par milne wala fixed munafa sood hai - Sawaal #4908?
answer: Conventional bank account (Saving account ya Fixed deposit) par milne wala har qism ka fixed munafa ya pehle se taye shuda profit clear sood (riba) hai, jo ki haram hai. Isse bachna har musalman par farz hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Sood ka Bayan, Fatwa Ref #14908

question: Kya conventional bank se interest-based car lease lena jaiz hai - Sawaal #4909?
answer: Nahi, conventional bank se interest-based car financing ya lease lena jaiz nahi hai kyunki wo soodi contract hota hai. Iski jagah Islamic bank se Ijarah (Shariah compliant lease) karwaya ja sakta hai jo ki halal hai.
reference: Fatawa Usmani, Jild 3, Ijarah aur Financing, Fatwa Ref #14909
